teamId.description: null releases them from their team

mode.description: Required for a paid puja: CASH, UPI, CARD, CHEQUE or BANK_TRANSFER

consentSource.description: Required on create; set once, ignored on update

fundId.description: Optional earmarked fund (ADR 0022); omit for the general fund

about.example: A 300-year-old Ganesh temple in the old city.

imageVersion.description: Set with PUT /temple/image; null when there is no photo

amount.description: Rupees as a decimal string, at most 2 decimals

devoteeId.description: Optional: links the donation to a devotee record

donorName.description: Required without devoteeId; ignored with one

fundId.description: Optional earmarked fund (ADR 0022); omit for the general fund

approved.description: Default true: staff registering someone approves them

note.example: Closed for the lunar eclipse; reopens tomorrow 5:30 am

status.description: null returns to the regular hours

icon.description: One of the listed icon names

info.description: Multi-tenant temple/trust management platform — devotees, donations (with 80G), and events. All endpoints are tenant-scoped and authorization is enforced server-side.
info.title: SevaCenter API
